# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

We actively provide security updates for the following versions:

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.1.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| 1.0.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0.0 | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take the security of SportsPress Admin Tools seriously. If you believe you have found a security vulnerability, please do not report it in a public issue. Instead, please follow the process below:

1. **Direct Report**: Please use the built-in [GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/security-advisories/guidance-on-reporting-and-post-reporting/reporting-a-vulnerability-to-a-repository) feature. You can find the **"Report a vulnerability"** button under the **Security** tab of this repository.
2. **Disclosure**: Provide a detailed summary of the vulnerability, including steps to reproduce it and a Proof of Concept (PoC) if possible.
3. **Response**: You can expect a response acknowledging your report within 48-72 hours.
4. **Handling**: We will coordinate the fix and disclosure process through a GitHub Security Advisory to ensure users are protected.

Thank you for helping keep this project secure!
